fire: Zoom out until both towers are visible in the frame.
Widen the window so that the text is big enough to read.
Shrink the photo to fit the page margins.
Tilt the camera until the whole group is in focus.
Rotate the mirror until the star is visible in the eyepiece.
Scale the chart down to fit the slide.
Pan left until all the signs are on the screen.

Widen the road so that the trucks can pass at noon.
Shrink the photo and email it to the office.
Tilt the camera and the strap comes loose.
Rotate the mirror and clean the dust from the eyepiece.
Print the chart and hand out the slide.
Turn left and walk past all the signs on the street.
Crop the picture and frame it for the hallway.

short: adjusting so something fits or shows
notes: Card: ' fit' x5, ' on', ' into', ' be', ' are', ' in', with zooming, scrollbars and focus examples.
